Message:
When I saw him
during the festival,
I thought my eyes were
playing tricks on me.
Showing me his
beautiful spirit
cast in shadow...

Wait, could it be that
the Curse of poison
wasn’t dispelled,
but only sealed
inside the Hero...?

Has it been like that...
all this time...?

He mustn’t be allowed
to continue—at this rate, he’ll die.

Wait, more than that...
if he takes in any more Curses,
he could lose his humanity
and turn into...

As I cried out in desperation,
the Hero just gently smiled at me.

“If the cost of saving
the world is my own life,
that’s a very small price to pay,”
he said.

...I knew he, the one who
possesses a spirit far nobler
than Lord Samyaza’s,
would say that.

Because he’s exactly
the kind of person that
the Staff would choose.

Thinking about it now,
I’m certain it was that
gentle smile of his...
that broke me.
